description:
About our brand and products:
Beard Octane Australia brings premium American beard care to Australia and New Zealand. Our products are made using high quality natural ingredients and are designed to help men grow healthier, fuller beards while keeping them soft, clean and well groomed.

Our range includes beard oils, beard balms, beard butters, beard wash, beard conditioner and grooming tools. Every product is formulated to nourish both the beard and the skin underneath, helping reduce itch, dryness and irritation while improving beard appearance and manageability.

What makes us different:
Beard Octane has built a strong reputation internationally for producing some of the highest quality beard care products available.

What sets us apart

• Premium natural ingredients with no harsh chemicals
• Unique scent profiles developed specifically for beard grooming
• High performance formulas that focus on beard health and skin care
• Trusted by barbers and grooming professionals
• Official Australian and New Zealand distribution ensuring fast local shipping

We are focused on delivering premium grooming products for men who take pride in their beard and appearance.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates can earn commission by promoting Beard Octane Australia through their website, social media channels, blogs or content platforms.

Affiliates receive

• Competitive commission on every sale
• Unique tracking links or discount codes
• Access to promotional material and product imagery
• Opportunity for product collaborations and content features

Our products appeal strongly to beard enthusiasts, grooming communities and lifestyle audiences, making them ideal for content creators in the men's grooming space.
payout_period: We instantly pay out commission over $25 AUD.
term_and_condition:
• For every sale made using your 'Affiliate Discount Code', the 'Customer' will receive 10% Off their entire order.  You, the 'Affiliate', will receive a 10% Commission from that order, to excluding shipping & taxes.• Lifetime Commission - The customer will automatically become "connected" to the Affiliate upon completing their first successful purchase.  The Affiliate will will automatically receive commission for any future purchases completed by that customer.  If a customer is already connected to a different Affiliate, the customer will still receive the discount amount, but the connected Affiliate will receive the commission.
  • Commission will not be factored against shipping costs, sales tax, & manufacturing affiliated costs.
  • Commissions on referrals will not be paid out until they reach a minimum balance of $25.
  • Monthly payouts will be delayed by 30 days, to better account for returns, order chargebacks, and other customer-related refund requests that impact commissions.
  • Affiliate accounts that are aligned solely with 'coupon style' shopping sites are not allowed.
  • Program Terms & Policies are subject to change without notification.
